_comment: League context for the commentary writer. Generated 2026-08-03 from League History Database + sidecar. Regenerate once a season, or after major trades.
format: 12-team head-to-head all categories on Fantrax since 2016. 16 categories. 7-team playoff.

Return of Belt to Ass.note: Did NOT qualify on record. Got the last spot by winning the July-only roto standings challenge. Also the DEFENDING CHAMPION (2025).

seedRules: Seeds 1 and 2 are protected from elimination after Week 1, but their records carry into later weeks, so a bad week still costs them.
profileHowToRead: leagueRanksOf12: 1 = best in the 12-team league for that category, 12 = worst. For hitter SO, H allowed, BB allowed and ERA, lower raw values are better, and the rank already accounts for that (rank 1 = fewest/best).
provenanceHowToRead: Keyed by player name. origin = how they entered 2026 (DRAFT with price and pick, KEEPER with price, IN_SEASON_ACQUISITION, PRESEASON_NONDRAFT). tradedTo/waiverClaims record in-season movement. Use this to credit a shrewd trade or a cheap waiver pickup when that player has a big game.
notes: Matt (Julio's Last Hurrah) is the commissioner and missed the 2026 playoffs, finishing 9th.
2025 was the league's first unlimited-keeper season.
